$comment: Declarative form of the submit_task request contract. Derived from src/service.mjs validateSubmitRequest (lines 302-392) and docs/task-contract.md#submit_task. Checked by src/contracts/validate.mjs; the meta block is ignored by the checker.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-scoped idempotency key; opaque to the service.

clientId.description: Service-configured client identity, never derived from task text.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Checkable acceptance criteria, at least one and at most twenty.

path.description: Absolute repository path that must resolve inside a configured writable root; the root check is configuration-relative and stays in code.

baseRef.description: Ref that must resolve to a commit.

branch.description: Branch the worker creates; must not already exist unless this task created it.

authorization.description: Requested authority. Subset checks against the configured allowlist are configuration-relative and stay in code.

items.description: provider/model entry; must be inside the configured allowlist.
read, edit, bash, ...; must be inside the configured allowlist.
Glob relative to repository.path, or an absolute path inside both the repository and a configured root.

limits.description: Task budgets. Positivity and budget ceilings are numeric bounds that the current checker subset cannot express (no minimum keyword), so they remain imperative until a later RFC widens the subset.

clientSessionId.description: Optional correlation metadata; not an authority and excluded from the idempotency hash.
